input_requirement: The system shall process 95 percent of all queries within 1.5 seconds and must not take longer than 4 seconds to process queries at any given time.

ambiguities.fragment: within 1.5 seconds" AND "not take longer than 4 seconds
ambiguities.explanation: The requirement contains a semantic ambiguity due to the lack of defined operator precedence between processing within '1.5 seconds' and not exceeding '4 seconds'. It is unclear whether these conditions are meant as an inclusive range (up to but not including 1.5 seconds) or if they represent separate, non-overlapping constraints.
possible_interpretations: The system must process all queries in a time frame that does not exceed either of the two specified durations: up to and excluding both 1.5 seconds.

The requirement specifies an inclusive processing window from zero to one point five seconds for some cases, while also imposing another constraint where no query should take longer than four seconds at any given moment.

ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: within 1.5 seconds" AND "not take longer than 4 seconds"
missing_information: The intended operator precedence between processing queries within 1.5 seconds and not exceeding four seconds.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text does not provide sufficient context to determine the relationship (inclusive or exclusive) of these two time constraints.
